reserveReview.rationale: Morpho identifies USDC as the Smokehouse vault asset and the vault as a Steakhouse-curated lending product. On 2026-10-27 a finalized-block Ethereum read (block 26282851, hash 0x2ce46d7e90bdb5c5e490e60debcad33e3dafdddd38d4a54fabd1ea16dec4eb22, timestamp 2026-10-27T08:29:11Z, matching before/after headers) returned vault asset() equal to native USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalAssets 12601857387693 raw (12,601,857.39 USDC) and an idle USDC balance of 4601 raw at the vault, so 99.99999996% of assets remain deployed in Morpho positions. The current live rows separate idle USDC from deployed Morpho positions; both retain the USDC wrapper dependency, while the deployed row carries borrower-credit, collateral, liquidity, and smart-contract risks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current ERC-4626 live rows and Morpho Smokehouse USDC vault identity, re-read at Ethereum block 26282851 (2026-10-27T08:29:11Z)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Assets are held by identifiable noncustodial vault and market contracts, with idle and market allocations changing over time. Contract-level isolation does not establish legal bankruptcy remoteness, and no static provider allocation is appropriate. Source-scoped correction. The source review rechecked the cited Morpho V1 contract documentation and exact Smokehouse product page on 2026-10-20: depositing USDC into borrower markets establishes intentional strategy lending, but neither source establishes a custodian's contractual right to repledge assets. The prior permitted legal-rehypothecation label conflated these different scopes and is withdrawn to unknown. Current Steakhouse vault terms likewise disclaim custody and fiduciary obligations without supplying legal reuse rights. Actual lending/capital reuse, all reserve risk factors, original review start and composition pins remain unchanged.
